WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id origin,p.parent_span_id next_id,[p.span_id] visited
                  FROM normal_traces p WHERE p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT x.trace_id,x.origin,a.parent_span_id,list_append(x.visited,a.span_id)
                  FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND NOT lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                    AND NOT list_contains(x.visited,a.span_id)
                ), caller_servers AS (
                  SELECT x.origin,a.* FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a
                    ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), pairs AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,
                    p.span_name client_operation,c.span_name server_operation,
                    p."attr.http.request.method" client_method,c."attr.http.request.method" server_method,
                    p.duration/1e6 client_ms,c.duration/1e6 server_ms,
                    (cast(p.duration AS DOUBLE)-cast(c.duration AS DOUBLE))/1e6 wait_ms,
                    coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) client_error,coalesce((c."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR c."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) server_error,
                    c.time >= p.time AND epoch_ns(c.time)::HUGEINT + c.duration <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration contained
                  FROM normal_traces p JOIN normal_traces c ON p.trace_id=c.trace_id AND p.span_id=c.parent_span_id
                  WHERE p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND c.service_name='ts-food-service'
                    AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client') AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), observed AS (
                  SELECT p.*,coalesce(coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false),false) caller_error,
                    a.duration/1e6 caller_ms,
                    a.time <= p.time AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT + a.duration >= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration caller_contains
                  FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN caller_servers a ON a.trace_id=p.trace_id AND a.origin=p.span_id
                ) SELECT client_operation,server_operation,count(*) n,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(client_method))) client_methods,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(server_method))) server_methods,
                    median(client_ms) median_ms,quantile_cont(client_ms,.95) p95_ms,
                    median(server_ms) server_ms,median(wait_ms) wait_ms,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error) errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error AND caller_error AND caller_contains) linked_errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE caller_contains AND contained AND client_ms>=20 AND client_ms>=caller_ms*.5) dominant_calls,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_method<>server_method) method_mismatch,
                    min(time) first_time,max(time) last_time
                  FROM observed GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id origin,p.parent_span_id next_id,[p.span_id] visited
                  FROM normal_traces p WHERE p.service_name='ts-preserve-service' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT x.trace_id,x.origin,a.parent_span_id,list_append(x.visited,a.span_id)
                  FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-preserve-service' AND NOT lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                    AND NOT list_contains(x.visited,a.span_id)
                ), caller_servers AS (
                  SELECT x.origin,a.* FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a
                    ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-preserve-service' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), pairs AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,
                    p.span_name client_operation,c.span_name server_operation,
                    p."attr.http.request.method" client_method,c."attr.http.request.method" server_method,
                    p.duration/1e6 client_ms,c.duration/1e6 server_ms,
                    (cast(p.duration AS DOUBLE)-cast(c.duration AS DOUBLE))/1e6 wait_ms,
                    coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) client_error,coalesce((c."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR c."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) server_error,
                    c.time >= p.time AND epoch_ns(c.time)::HUGEINT + c.duration <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration contained
                  FROM normal_traces p JOIN normal_traces c ON p.trace_id=c.trace_id AND p.span_id=c.parent_span_id
                  WHERE p.service_name='ts-preserve-service' AND c.service_name='ts-food-service'
                    AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client') AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), observed AS (
                  SELECT p.*,coalesce(coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false),false) caller_error,
                    a.duration/1e6 caller_ms,
                    a.time <= p.time AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT + a.duration >= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration caller_contains
                  FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN caller_servers a ON a.trace_id=p.trace_id AND a.origin=p.span_id
                ) SELECT client_operation,server_operation,count(*) n,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(client_method))) client_methods,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(server_method))) server_methods,
                    median(client_ms) median_ms,quantile_cont(client_ms,.95) p95_ms,
                    median(server_ms) server_ms,median(wait_ms) wait_ms,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error) errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error AND caller_error AND caller_contains) linked_errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE caller_contains AND contained AND client_ms>=20 AND client_ms>=caller_ms*.5) dominant_calls,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_method<>server_method) method_mismatch,
                    min(time) first_time,max(time) last_time
                  FROM observed GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
